name: brand-assets
body:
Brand assets: repo-root `brand/` directory holding:
- `brand/logo_dark.svg`: dark-filled hexagon tile, for dark backgrounds.
- `brand/logo_light.svg`: light-filled hexagon tile, for light backgrounds.
- `brand/LICENSE`: all rights reserved, Really Knows AI, plus the trademark statement.
Both SVGs are split and recoloured from the user-supplied logo SVG per solution.note.brand-mark-source, keeping the path geometry unchanged, using a square cropped viewBox and only `#0F1115`/`#F8F9FA`/`#FF5722`. The wordmark is plain "kalide" text in lowercase Helvetica in docs, not an asset. The files are referenced only from README.md (which may switch between the two SVGs via `<picture>`/`prefers-color-scheme`), package-channel descriptions and an optional GitHub social preview. NOT part of embedded-assets; never go:embed'ed; never referenced from the served page shells; not covered by the root Apache-2.0 LICENSE (see requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded). implemented-by deferred: `brand/*` files do not exist yet — plan declares them as planned file nodes.
